integrity: Self-contained direct analytic proof, with independent finite linear-program checks described separately. No claim to third-party certification, authorship, independent audit, or universal novelty.
scientific_limitations: Real signed zero-total-mass measures with absolutely summable leaf coefficients on an equal-arm star of positive radius. Not asserted for unequal arm lengths, arbitrary nonzero total mass, or complex tests; the general finite-metric linear-program method and the classical two-point identity are prior art.
title: Exact Dudley norms and mass-imbalance thresholds on equiradial stars
